en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone alley framed by old stucco buildings, leading toward an arched passage with windows above it. Beyond the arch rises a church or civic tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock faces. The lower margin of the image contains printed caption text giving the location and title, and the photographer's credit appears in the bottom right margin.
